arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Where the Dockerfile-to-image mappings come from: 'direct' (the mappings argument) or 'source' (a JSON file).

arguments.name: mappings
arguments.description: Dockerfile path to target base image mapping; required when mode is 'direct'.

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: JSON file mapping Dockerfile paths to target base images; required when mode is 'source'.

outputs.name: build_required
outputs.description: Whether any Dockerfile changed so an image build is needed.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: Images (with their Dockerfile) that require a build.

outputs.name: changes
outputs.description: FROM line changes made, one entry per Dockerfile (dockerfile, from, to).
